intended_object: The A-algebra homomorphism A[W,Y,T] → Q[1/w], where Q = A[w,x,y,z]/(wz − xy), sending W ↦ w, Y ↦ y, T ↦ x/w. It is the polynomial part of the inverse of the chart isomorphism Q[1/w] ≅ A[W,Y,T][1/W]. Inferred from the docstring and from its use in `chartBackward`.
explanation: The body is `MvPolynomial.aeval` on `Fin 3`. It sends index 0 (`W`) to the image of w, index 1 (`Y`) to the image of y, and index 2 (`T`) to the image of x times `IsLocalization.Away.invSelf w`, i.e. x·w⁻¹. This matches the variable order `W, Y, T` fixed in the file and the docstring. It is also the right inverse assignment for the parametrization phi : (w,x,y,z) ↦ (W, WT, Y, YT), since x = WT and W = w give T = x/w. The coefficient ring A is an arbitrary commutative ring, and the target is any model of the localization at w (it only needs an `IsLocalization.Away` instance). It is a specific morphism tied to this particular quadric, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib supplies the general tools it uses (`aeval`, `IsLocalization.Away.invSelf`) but has no counterpart for this specific map.
